items.source: This implementation opens a FileChannel for the underlying file.
items.translation: 此实现会为底层文件打开一个 FileChannel。

items.source: path - a file path
items.translation: path - 文件路径

items.source: Note: When building relative resources via createRelative(String), the relative path will apply at the same directory level: for example, Paths.get("C:/dir1"), relative path "dir2" → "C:/dir2"! If you prefer to have relative paths built underneath the given root directory, use the constructor with a file path to append a trailing slash to the root path: "C:/dir1/", which indicates this directory as root for all relative paths. Alternatively, consider using PathResource(Path) for java.nio.path.Path resolution in createRelative, always nesting relative paths.
items.translation: 注意：通过 `createRelative(String)` 构建相对资源时，相对路径将应用于相同的目录级别；例如，Paths.get("C:/dir1")，相对路径 "dir2" → "C:/dir2"！如果您希望相对路径构建在指定的根目录之下，请使用 带文件路径的构造函数 在根路径末尾添加斜杠："C:/dir1/"，以此将该目录指定为所有相对路径的根。或者，考虑使用 PathResource(Path) 用于 java.nio.path.Path 在 createRelative 中的解析，以始终嵌套相对路径。

items.source: Note: This Resource implementation uses NIO.2 API for read/write interactions and may be constructed with a Path handle in which case it will perform all file system interactions via NIO.2, only resorting to File on getFile().
items.translation: 注意：此Resource实现使用 NIO.2 API 进行读写操作，并且可以使用一个Path句柄进行构建；在这种情况下，它将仅通过 NIO.2 执行所有文件系统操作，仅在调用getFile()时才会回退到使用File。

items.source: In contrast to PathResource, this variant strictly follows the general FileSystemResource conventions, in particular in terms of path cleaning and createRelative(String) handling.
items.translation: 与PathResource相比，此变体严格遵循通用的FileSystemResource约定，特别是在路径清理和createRelative(String)处理方面。

items.source: Note: When building relative resources via createRelative(String), the relative path will apply at the same directory level: for example, new File("C:/dir1"), relative path "dir2" → "C:/dir2"! If you prefer to have relative paths built underneath the given root directory, use the constructor with a file path to append a trailing slash to the root path: "C:/dir1/", which indicates this directory as root for all relative paths.
items.translation: 注意：通过 createRelative(String) 构建相对资源时，相对路径将应用于相同的目录级别：例如，new File("C:/dir1")，相对路径 "dir2" → "C:/dir2"！如果您希望相对路径构建在指定的根目录之下，请使用 带文件路径的构造函数 在根路径后添加尾随斜杠："C:/dir1/"，以此将该目录指定为所有相对路径的根目录。

items.source: This is an alternative to FileSystemResource(String), performing all file system interactions via NIO.2 instead of File.
items.translation: 这是 `FileSystemResource(String)` 的替代方案，通过 NIO.2 而非 File 执行所有文件系统交互。

items.source: Note: When building relative resources via createRelative(String), it makes a difference whether the specified resource base path here ends with a slash or not. In the case of "C:/dir1/", relative paths will be built underneath that root: for example, relative path "dir2" → "C:/dir1/dir2". In the case of "C:/dir1", relative paths will apply at the same directory level: relative path "dir2" → "C:/dir2".
items.translation: 注意：通过 `createRelative(String)` 构建相对资源时，此处指定的资源基础路径是否以斜杠结尾会有所不同。对于 "C:/dir1/" 的情况，相对路径将构建在该根目录之下：例如，相对路径 "dir2" → "C:/dir1/dir2"。对于 "C:/dir1" 的情况，相对路径将应用于同一目录级别：相对路径 "dir2" → "C:/dir2"。

items.source: This implementation returns the underlying File/Path length.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层 File/Path 的长度。

items.source:
This implementation creates a FileSystemResource, applying the given path
relative to the path of the underlying file of this resource descriptor.
items.translation: 此实现会创建一个 FileSystemResource，其路径相对于该资源描述符底层文件的路径。

items.source: This implementation compares the underlying file paths.
items.translation: 此实现比较底层文件路径。

items.source: This implementation returns whether the underlying file exists.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层文件是否存在。

items.source: Return the contents of this resource as a byte array.
items.translation: 返回该资源的内容作为字节数组。

items.source: Return the contents of this resource as a string, using the specified charset.
items.translation: 使用指定的字符集将该资源的内容作为字符串返回。

items.source:
This implementation returns a description that includes the absolute
path of the file.
items.translation: 此实现返回一个包含文件绝对路径的描述。

items.source: This implementation returns the underlying File reference.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层的 File 引用。

items.source: This implementation returns the name of the file.
items.translation: 此实现返回文件名。

items.source: This implementation returns the underlying NIO Path reference.
items.translation: 该实现返回底层的 NIO Path 引用。

items.source: This implementation opens an NIO file stream for the underlying file.
items.translation: 此实现为底层文件打开一个 NIO 文件流。

items.source: This implementation opens a FileOutputStream for the underlying file.
items.translation: 此实现会为底层文件打开一个 FileOutputStream。

items.source: Return the file path for this resource.
items.translation: 返回该资源的路径。

items.source: This implementation returns a URI for the underlying file.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层文件的 URI。

items.source: This implementation returns a URL for the underlying file.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层文件的 URL。

items.source: This implementation returns the hash code of the underlying file path.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层文件路径的哈希码。

items.source: This implementation always indicates a file.
items.translation: 此实现始终指示一个文件。

items.source:
This implementation checks whether the underlying file is marked as readable
(and corresponds to an actual file with content, not to a directory).
items.translation: 此实现检查底层文件是否标记为可读（且对应于包含内容的实际文件，而非目录）。

items.source:
This implementation checks whether the underlying file is marked as writable
(and corresponds to an actual file with content, not to a directory).
items.translation: 此实现会检查底层文件是否被标记为可写（且对应的是包含内容的实际文件，而非目录）。

items.source: This implementation returns the underlying File/Path last-modified time.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层文件或路径的最后修改时间。
